title: Keep the later full-entropy witness provisional
statement: The later16391-byte solo interim proof uses a bounded entropy payoff cone H_s+phi*(H_a)<=0 and transfers finite witnesses to confidence bounds on realised entropy on a stationary all-even hidden record. Its binary lag-two receiver avoids a huge optimization for that witness. The general hierarchy targets LEAST hidden dissipation compatible with the FULL observed ERGODIC law;it does not recover arbitrary invisible excess dissipation or solve unknown stationary ensemble mean-rate inference. General finite-at-each-stage enumeration lacks a useful uniform budget. The roughly4369nat endpoint on an OLD CTMC record is retrospective;fresh frozen matched controls remain pending. Earlier dependencies are byte-identical,reconciled to the preserved0212flow proof. Later final must be a separate version.
